title: S01 74HC00 NAND plus S02 74HC02 NOR using accepted combinational path
logical_expression: Y1 = nand(A1, B1); Y2 = nor(A2, B2)
description: Focused replacement for failed pairwise P001_S01_S02. Uses fresh accepted gate records and generated CDB rows instead of whole-donor U2 chunk copying.

normalizations.hidden_supply: Ignore user pin 14/VCC/+5V and pin 7/GND/0V for every 74HCxx package.
normalizations.terminal_policy: IC signal pins use $TERINPUT/$TEROUTPUT. R/C/L endpoints use $TERBIDIR. Power/ground terminals only appear when passive branches need V0/G0.
